scope: Reference pilot target based on the available Mac; not a claim about all desktops or mobile devices

target.runtime: Native MSE browser playback plus one local Python/PyTorch inference worker
target.browser_measurement_scope: One isolated Chrome process tree; other user tabs are outside this measurement

memory_budget.measurement: Sample browser process-tree RSS and server RSS at the same time; keep JS heap diagnostic separate and do not add it to RSS twice
cautions: RSS sums can count shared pages multiple times
Sampled peaks are not guaranteed maxima
A warm-worker measurement does not prove server peak during full HTTP playback
Current historical runs do not establish the 30-minute memory-growth requirement

quality_budget.priority: Avoid stalls; continue emergency playback if required, show degraded quality and fail the quality acceptance gate rather than force an unsafe upgrade
quality_budget.interpretation: Normal-quality floor and emergency exposure limits are proposals, not measured human acceptability or VMAF thresholds
quality_budget.human_review: Review both videos at the actual player size for motion, faces and text before accepting this floor

evaluation_rule: Diagnostic assessment of existing evidence only; freeze this profile before new independent acceptance trials, retain startup failures and do not use these post-hoc limits to promote a checkpoint
implementation: Documentation and audit profile only; these limits are not runtime-enforced and do not change existing policies, weights or defaults
